snippet.title: GAS N CARS - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
*Gas N Cars is a chaotic VR gas station sandbox where serving customers is only half the fun.*

Fuel cars, earn cash, unlock crazy tools, complete wild missions, catch fugitives, recycle objects, open mystery loot boxes… or just create total chaos with paint, weapons, explosions and angry customers.

Get ready to run the most unhinged gas station in VR!

https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/gas-n-cars-summer-chaos-update/26861349570161785/

https://gasncars.com/
